All 6 registered pages fetched fresh this session with the FULL browser header set (a UA-only request is Cloudflare-403 and r.jina.ai has been dead on wowhead.com/guide/* since 2026-08-03), HTTP 200, 76,048-346,068 bytes. Parsed the documented way: unescape \\/ to / across the whole document FIRST, then locate the [tier-list=rows] ... [/tier-list] blocks and take the largest rather than anchoring on WH.markup.printHtml( — each page returned exactly one block this run (27/7/6/27/7/6 spec-badges), so no decoy was in play, but the selection rule is what makes that verifiable. (2) The Wowhead blue-tracker index parsed from its JSON script block id="data.blueTracker.default" by brace-balancing from the id attribute — 40 entries, ~30 unique topics. NEW BUILD ENTRY, kind "build": "Class Tuning Incoming -- September 22" (Linxy, us.forums topic 2354340, post 1, created 2026-09-18T23:03:10Z), the third of the three weekly Season 2 tuning passes from Blizzard's 2026-08-12 roadmap, read from the forum Discourse JSON AT VERSION 2 with its heading nesting intact. 24 specsAffected and 24 highlights, all reconciled against the coverage gate. Wowhead's mirror (news=382999, published 23:05:34Z, i.e. off v1) was diffed line by line against v2: EXACTLY ONE PvE line differs (Blood DK's aura cut reads "All ability and minion damage reduced by 6%" in v2 against "All ability damage reduced by 6%" in the mirror); the forum wording is stored. Druid's Bursting Growth line sits under a bare "Hero Talents > Wildstalker" block that is a SIBLING of the spec blocks, so it is logged class-wide rather than guessed onto a spec. The whole PLAYER VERSUS PLAYER section is out of scope and was not distilled (9 specs appear there and nowhere in the Classes section), and one PvE-section line that is itself PvP-only — Discipline Priest's "Atonement healing is no longer increased by 40% in PvP combat" — was deliberately NOT written as a highlight per the 3c rule, while its PvE sibling was. NO SET BONUS is touched anywhere in the post, so no spec.tierSet asOf moved and the tier-set upkeep gate is satisfied without a gearing resync. Every line was run through classifyHighlight rather than assumed: 21 buffs and 3 deliberate nulls (Blood DK, Survival Hunter, Shadow Priest are genuinely mixed and correctly do not vote). SECOND ENTRY, kind "hotfix", same date: the datamined Ula'tek Stone Venom range change (Wowhead news=382998) — encounter tuning with NO class or spec line, so specsAffected is empty and its single highlight carries the "Non-class:" prefix (the posts #7/#12/#13 precedent). The 12.1.5 lane stays notes-only: PHASES.ptr untouched, nothing from 12.1.5 written into ptr-builds.builds, spec.ptr, tier sets or any model input. Recorded from this run's deterministic pre-agent evidence, brackets["wcl-leaderboard-raid"] (wcl-fetch/evidence.json, attemptedAt 2026-09-19T13:58:33Z): status "invalid", 0 rows, against a minRows of 200. Every cut carries the same detail — "Zone identity/season/encounter/difficulty/keystone metadata differs from reviewed configuration" — for the reviewed raid recipe (zone 53, partition 1, difficulty 5, size 20). The root cause was already established in the 2026-09-18 local run and is unchanged tonight: WCL has added encounter 3513 (Kith’ix, the 12.1.5 boss) to zone 53, and zoneValid refuses any encounter outside the reviewed list, so the whole raid bracket reports invalid. That is a one-line REVIEWED recipe change and is deliberately not made here. Per the standing rule an invalid cut is reported as parse_error, its previous observations are retained unchanged, and identity is never inferred agent-side from shared names or id patterns.
